<thought>We need to retrieve polymorphs for a diverse set of oxide compositions (up to 40). Use the provided max_energy_above_hull=0.3 and max_per_composition=3. We'll select ~30 common oxides and retrieve them in batch, saving to a directory within the workspace. Then we will consolidate the individual JSON files into a single dataset and return its path.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "TiO2","SiO2","Al2O3","Fe2O3","FeO","Fe3O4","CuO","Cu2O","ZnO","MgO",
        "CaO","SrO","BaO","CoO","NiO","MnO","Cr2O3","V2O5","MoO3","WO3",
        "PbO","PbO2","SnO2","Bi2O3","Ti3O5","ZrO2","HfO2","Nb2O5","Ta2O5",
        "La2O3","CeO2","Nd2O3","Sm2O3","Gd2O3","Y2O3","Sc2O3","Ti2O3","GeO2","In2O3"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/0_batch_retrieve_oxide_polymorphs_trial_13/oxides_data"
}
